data.description:
## Summary

Make a completion-verifier run performed OUTSIDE a close transition RECORD its result on the
ticket, so a later close at the SAME `--ref` REUSES that certified PASS instead of firing a
duplicate (billable) verifier run. This is the recording half that composes with the already
implemented close-time reuse (`close_autoresume._reusable_attested_pass`); it makes standalone
completion verification symmetric with `review-plan` (which already signs its attestation and
emits its sidecar).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A new best-effort producer `transition_close.record_completion_verdict(result, ticket_id,
      repo_root, *, sign=True)` emits the `COMPLETION_VERDICT` sidecar (PASS/FAIL) and, on an
      attested, certifiable PASS pinned to a `verified_at_sha`, signs the reusable
      `completion-verifier` op-cert via the shared producer `sign_completion_verdict`. It never
      signs a `local`/uncertifiable/non-PASS verdict and never raises.
- [x] `rebar verify-completion` records by default with a `--no-sign` opt-out (symmetric with
      `review-plan`'s `--no-sign`); text output reports what was recorded. The committed CLI
      help artifact is regenerated.
- [x] The MCP `verify_completion` tool records unless the server is read-only; the outcome
      rides on the result's `record` field.
- [x] Tests prove a standalone attested PASS is signed and REUSED by a later same-ref close
      (verifier provider never called), and that `--no-sign` / `local` source / `certifiable=
      False` / FAIL each record correctly without signing.
- [x] Targeted lint (ruff + C901 complexity ratchet), format, mypy, and the completion
      reuse/close/facade/help suites pass.

## Files

- `src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py` — new `record_completion_verdict` helper.
- `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py` — wire recording + `_render_record_line`.
- `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/llm.py` — `--no-sign` flag.
- `src/rebar/_cli/help/verify-completion.txt` — regenerated help.
- `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py` — record on the MCP tool.
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_standalone_completion_record.py` — new tests.
data.title: Record standalone completion-verifier runs on the ticket for close-time reuse
